description:
The highly caffeinated Git GUI

Git Cola is a sleek and powerful graphical user interface for Git. It is free
software and written in Python (v2 + v3).
Git Cola v4.20.0

• Undo + Redo support for most commands, including destructive Git operations such as reverting unstaged content and all index editing operations!
• Experimental server mode for running a Git Cola session on a remote machine!
• Improved SVG rendering in Image Diff mode!
• See the changelog for more details.

User Guide：https://git-cola.readthedocs.io/en/latest/
Changelog：https://git-cola.readthedocs.io/en/latest/relnotes.html
All Changes：https://gitlab.com/git-cola/git-cola/-/compare/v4.19.0...v4.20.0
